scope: Bounded malformed Solid BACKGROUND body recovery with strict refusal and explicit-partial ASCII/Binary readback.

source.kind: scratch-only DWGs authored at test runtime by the in-tree DWG writer; each valid typed seed is converted to a raw mutated frame and injected with matching custom-class registration
source.object: Solid BACKGROUND class version 0 with generated solid color 0x123456; no owner, reactor, or type-specific handle dependency is added.
source.bodyMutation: One bit is flipped after the validated common prologue. AC1015 searches only the remaining bounded object-frame bytes because its bodyBitSize is zero; modern revisions search only the declared object body span.

excludedVersions.AC1021: The bounded post-prologue/body-span search found no one-bit mutation that makes the typed parser fail.
excludedVersions.AC1024: The bounded declared-body-span search found no one-bit mutation that makes the typed parser fail.

implementation.controls: Each eligible reader records one object parse failure and one failed object frame, retains the following LINE callback, and balances source = published + failed. Strict ASCII/Binary conversion refuses atomically. Explicit-partial ASCII/Binary conversion succeeds at AC1015/AC1018/AC1032; fresh DXF readback contains the retained LINE and VPORT. AC1027 reader recovery succeeds but both CLI modes refuse at the existing DWG source-reference qualification gate. The input DWGs remain unchanged.

results.outputQualification: Explicit-partial ASCII/Binary conversion and readback pass at AC1015/AC1018/AC1032. AC1027 is reader-only behind the source-reference gate. No claim is made for AC1021/AC1024 or the other Background variants.

validation.focusedControl: check_malformed_background_solid_body: PASS; 18 strict/partial/readback controls across AC1015/AC1018/AC1027/AC1032

limitations: Generated parser-recovery and CLI disposition only; the output/readback result covers this Solid subtype and generated field profile.
No other Background subtype, native visual semantics, producer prevalence, or interoperability is established.
AC1021/AC1024 are excluded because no parser-failing mutation was found in the bounded body span searched.
AC1027 output remains unqualified behind the source-reference closure gate.
No support claim is promoted and no DWG/DXF fixture is committed.
